name: America East Cross Country Championships
headline: America East Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: UMass Lowell won the men's title with 49 points, ahead of Vermont (61), UMBC (69) and Binghamton (72); Binghamton's Robert Mayclim won the 8K in 23:59.7. Vermont took the women's title with 61 points over Maine (69) and UMass Lowell (101), while UMass Lowell's Mary-Kate Finn won the 5K in 17:05.7.
